applicability: questions that turn on presence or absence of literal entries; excludes deterministic raw-byte reads

evidence.source_reference: GRAPH-002 drafting external sweep, 2026-08-12: paired fetches of anthropics/claude-code CHANGELOG.md in one researcher session

expected_behavior: When a conclusion hinges on the presence or absence of a literal changelog or release-note entry, re-fetch with a quote-verbatim prompt; a summarizing read is not evidence of absence.
observation: A summarizing WebFetch of the Claude Code changelog reported no workflow-specific changes for versions that a verbatim-quote re-fetch showed contained workflow entries (the 2.1.223 workflow-sandbox import() fix).
reason: The governing rule is already landed in the researcher method: when a claim hinges on a literal string, quote, count or version, read the raw artifact deterministically rather than trusting a summarized fetch. That text predates this observation by eight days, so the failure occurred under the existing rule rather than in its absence. The residual delta is one clause, that a summarizing read is not evidence of absence, so a negative conclusion about a changelog entry needs a verbatim re-fetch. Retired into the survivor that owns the single retrieval-path edit; that edit must carry the absence clause or the lesson is lost.
